name: Rupturing Clasp
description: Clasp a limb and burst its vessels in a single squeeze so the arm goes dead and bleeds under the skin.

name: Crimson Chain
description: Spin a chain of blood-qi from the wrist that links itself to the target's pulse and holds.

name: Bloodtide Lash
description: Lash out a heavy tide of blood-qi that breaks a stance and sends the target reeling.

name: Heartstring Pull
description: Pull on the string that ties the target's heart to the user's until they stumble into a blow.

name: Arterial Deluge
description: Loose a deluge of pressure from the user's arteries that sprays outward and cuts at close range.

name: Pulse Shatter
description: Break the beat of a target's heart with one hard blow so its limbs lose their coordination.

name: Hemal Spear
description: Thrust a spear of condensed blood-qi through armor and flesh to open the great vessels beneath.

name: Bloodmoon Mantle
description: Wear a round mantle of red qi that turns blows aside and feeds on the blood the user has spilled.

name: Red Cataract
description: Pour a cataract of heavy blood-qi from above that crushes what it falls on and sweeps the rest aside.

name: Scarlet Execution
description: Pass a hand over a marked target and open every vessel in its body together in a final cut.

name: Vital Drain
description: Draw the blood-qi from a wounded target through a held limb and turn it into the user's own vigor.

name: Crimson Sovereign
description: The school's command in which the user takes the pulse of every nearby body into one great rhythm and bends it.

name: Crimson Cataclysm
description: Raise the blood of every body in reach to the tier's destructive ceiling and burst it outward in a red flood.

name: Sanguine Apocalypse
description: Call every pulse in reach into one beat and stop it at once up to the ceiling of the tier's destruction.

name: Ebbtide Mend
description: Ease the ebb of blood from a wound with a warm returning tide for an ally or the self.

name: Clearing Surge
description: Surge clean blood-qi through an ally to clear poison and taint from the whole body.

name: Lifeblood Pour
description: Pour the healer's own lifeblood-qi into an ally to mend their wounds and lift their strength.

name: Heartstay
description: Hold a fragile ally's heart in a stay of warm qi so a blow does not stop it.

name: Stopped-Heart Recall
description: Strike the chest and drive a pulse of qi into a heart that stopped within the last few breaths.

name: Vital Aegis
description: Spread an aegis of living blood-qi over a wounded circle of allies while the healing proceeds.

name: Thawing Pulse
description: Warm a chilled and poisoned body with a thawing pulse that melts taint out of the blood.

name: Beat Reclaimed
description: Reclaim a lost heartbeat in one who has just fallen by seizing the last of their pulse.

name: Lifeblood Deluge
description: Send a deluge of warm living blood-qi over a wounded crowd that closes their hurts together.

name: Heart Eternal
description: Hold a heart beating against the pull of death for the moments needed to mend it.

name: Red Renewal
description: Renew the blood of a poisoned ally whole and replace what the taint has taken.

name: Final Heartbeat
description: The school's last beat in which the healer lends a living pulse to a fallen heart within the narrow window.

name: Pulse Undying
description: The school's undying pulse in which the healer shares one beat among the wounded so none falls.

name: Great Revival
description: Restart the stopped hearts of every fallen ally in reach within the narrow window up to the ceiling of the tier's restoring power.

name: Sanguine Resurrection
description: Call back one just fallen with a flood of lifeblood that also cleans the taint that killed them.
